discovery_notes: Cell B398, follow-up 20 of B041 (reuses keys from 397/445/478/505/526/546/564/575). 27 standard searches; all claims from search-engine summaries. New: TDR Style Studio winter 2021 (1 Dec 2021) and spring 2021 (2 Mar 2021) silhouette pins; HKDL Castle of Magical Dreams Collection gold pin (HK$899, 29 Oct 2021) plus Origins of the World pins (set only); SHDR Seven Dwarfs Mine Train mystery seven (OE, 24 Jan 2022, per-dwarf), Judy Hopps / Chip n Dale / Iron Man 5th anniversary LE800, The Sound Shanghai stage-scene LE300, monthly LE series 11-12 (Hotel; Lumiere & Cogsworth, 10 Jul 2020), Dancing Contest 2020 Chip 'n' Dale CM LE3000, Play in the Park Donald LE500 / Mickey OE, Into the Film jumbo LE500; sets only (structure holds): Warm Christmas Wishes 2022, Boba Tea 2021, Marvel Comics / Emblems 2020, Into the Film box/mystery, Play in the Park canvas, Sketch Slider 2020. No holds released. Gaps from the ledger mostly unresolved. Resellers seen, not used: carousell, rakuten/wizmouse.
